slots.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

slots.title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

slots.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

slots.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation Project.
